citation.title: CFD analysis of the KP505 propeller in open water (MARINE 2023)

anchors.declared_limit: PROVENANCE GAP (honest): the primary KRISO/KCS-workshop EFD handout and the Hino (2005) Tokyo-2015 proceedings were not reachable from this sandbox (egress allowlist). The transcribed curve is a SECONDARY reproduction: the 'Experimental' columns of Table 2 of Iftikhar & Takinaci, MARINE 2023.
header_quotes: Table 2. Comparison of CFD and Experimental Results

eta0_identity.formula: eta0 = J * KT / (2 * pi * KQ)  with  KQ = 10KQ / 10

hull.note: displacement is a VOLUME in m^3 for this API: the geometry gate of calculations/resistance rejects L*B*T*Cb vs displacement mismatch >= 5 % (a call with displacement=45000.0 was rejected with 'displacement=45000.0 m3 ... 相差 15.46%'). The propulsion endpoint accepts the same 45000.0 without that gate and returns identical numbers, i.e. it does not consume displacement at all.

propeller.declared_by: implicit platform constant: the returned K_T/K_Q at J=0.5372, P/D=0.95 are reproduced to 4 dp by the Oosterveld & van Oossanen 39/47-term regression at Z=5, Ae/Ao=0.70 (see artefact section propulsion_block_kt_kq_anchor_check)
propeller.prop_pitch_field_semantics: prop_pitch is read as the P/D RATIO, not as a pitch length: a call with prop_pitch=5.4 and prop_diameter=6.0 returned validity note 'P/D=5.400 超出 B 系列回归有效域 [0.5, 1.4]'

grid_definition.states: 11 states: S1..S6 speed sweep at 100 rpm (12..17 kn); S7..S10 rpm sweep at 15 kn (85/90/95/105 rpm); S11 P/D 1.05 at 15 kn / 100 rpm
grid_definition.note: this is THIS mission's grid.  The wave audit's own 11-state list is not held in this worktree, so the audit count is reported as a reproduction in count, not as the identification of the same states

receipts.resistance_method: ITTC-57 摩擦线 + ITTC-78 ks 粗糙度补贴 + Holtrop-1982/1984 剩余阻力（(1+k) 形状因子 + 兴波回归 + 球鼻/艉封板/附体）
receipts.precision_note: tool channel call_ship_api (shell curl to the loopback API is blocked by the worktree sandbox policy), so the receipts are transcribed from the tool's return payload; field-level precision is exactly the precision the endpoint returned (2 dp for kW, 4 dp for non-dimensional quantities), which bounds the identity residuals quoted in the artefact at ~1e-3 relative and is declared there.

summary.verdict: the platform's relative_rot_eff is a CONSTANT equal to 1.0000 on all 11 states (and hull_eff is the constant 1.0700); the multiplicative identity eta_D = eta_H eta_R eta_O therefore closes to rounding error by construction, which is exactly why it has no diagnostic power.  Inverting the identity against the resistance module's independent P_E puts 9/11 states outside [0.90, 1.10]

honest_notes: The Oosterveld & van Oossanen anchor is a CLOSED-FORM anchor: the printed NSMB tables are not in this worktree, so no table digit is claimed.  What is claimed is that the published 39/47-term regression, fed the machine-chain coefficients already registered in benchmarks/anchors/wageningen_b_series.json, reproduces the registered B4-70 curve and satisfies the efficiency identity.

The KP505 anchor is a LITERATURE_TABLE anchor but a SECONDARY_REPRODUCTION: the digits are the 'Experimental' columns of Table 2 of Iftikhar & Takinaci (MARINE 2023), not the KRISO handout; the paper does not state where its experimental column came from.

The eta_R window judgement on the platform path is possible at all only because the resistance module and the propulsion module are independent code paths; without that second P_E the identity is a tautology (see etaR_audit.summary).
Receipt precision: the archived endpoint fields carry 2 dp (kW) / 4 dp (dimensionless), which is what bounds the identity residuals at ~1e-3, not a solver effect.
